multifunctional-landscapes.title: Our goal
multifunctional-landscapes.intro: The goal of the Multifunctional Landscapes Science Program is to enable productive, biodiverse, climate-resilient, and socially inclusive landscapes, where progress on food security, climate action, biodiversity, and livelihoods reinforces rather than undermines each other. By 2030, MFL contributes to CGIAR portfolio ambitions to:
